content.text: `partial_trace` expects integer subsystem indices, not register objects. I’ll expand the selected registers into their circuit-wide qubit indices, leaving the circuit unchanged.

output.arguments:
{"command":""$PY" - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('buggy.py')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('# BUG: passing QuantumRegister objects directly to partial_trace instead of qubit indices', '# Trace out every qubit in the selected registers using circuit-wide indices.')
s = s.replace('density_matrix = partial_trace(result.get_statevector(), traced_over_registers)', 'traced_over_qubits = [\n    qc.find_bit(qubit).index\n    for register in traced_over_registers\n    for qubit in register\n]\ndensity_matrix = partial_trace(result.get_statevector(), traced_over_qubits)')
p.write_text(s)
PY
"$PY" buggy.py"}
output.name: bash
